name: 048_floor_grass_01.png
source: D:/Works/Unity's/Personal/Z_Plugin/Z_Plugin/ExtraAssets/元气骑士/斯大林制地砖_拆分/01_floor/048_floor_grass_01.png
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached quiet pixel-art grass floor tile. The user specifically wants the grass GRAIN/PARTICLES made LARGER, while retaining the previous calm simple design.
Maintain the current muted yellow-green base color, sparse layout, low contrast and flat overhead opaque square terrain. Final game tile is exactly 64x64 logical pixels, displayed enlarged.
Replace the almost invisible one-pixel specks with clearly readable COARSER color clusters. Each visible grain must measure approximately 3x3 logical pixels, with some 2x3 and 3x4 logical-pixel shapes. At 1024x1024 output a 3x3 logical-pixel cluster is 48x48 output pixels, so the marks must be visibly broad and chunky, not pinpoints. Use around 20-26 modest irregular grain clusters dispersed evenly across the whole tile. They can be softly angular stair-step patches or short chunky pixel dashes, not tiny isolated single-pixel dots. Keep total marked area around 5-7 percent by leaving broad calm blank base around them.
The clusters are subtle flat color variation in short grass: muted slightly darker olive-green and slightly lighter yellow-green, just 4-7 RGB levels from the base. Keep every cluster similar low visual weight. Preserve the approximate base #7DA34B. No saturated yellow, bright highlights, dark spots, large grass bushes, tall grass blades, flower-like tufts, stones, cloud-shaped broad patches or large mottled islands. No dense micro-noise. Crisp hard pixel edges, limited flat colors, no blur or gradient/vignette.
Seamlessly tileable opposite edges, with matching uniform base color and balanced edge density, no border or lighting difference from edge to edge. Avoid any focal point or recognizable repeating large motif. No text, labels or watermark. Make the grain size several times more readable than in the input, while keeping the texture sparse. Variant 1: balanced irregular scatter of mostly compact 3x3 clusters, some small stepped corners.
contrastPrompt:
Use case: lighting-weather. Edit only the CONTRAST of the attached coarse-grain pixel grass tile.
The coarse 2-4 logical-pixel grain sizes and irregular sparse placement are correct and MUST stay exactly the same. Keep square composition, crisp pixel edges, uniform opaque green ground and all cluster sizes/counts/positions. The only requested change is drastically reducing the brightness and saturation contrast of ALL the individual grass clusters.
The existing pale yellow clusters are much too bright and the dark clusters too dark. Recolor every light cluster to green just slightly lighter than the ground, and every dark cluster to green just slightly darker. Both must look like tone-on-tone GREEN, with absolutely no yellow or cream marks. Aim for roughly one fifth of the existing cluster contrast, so they blend quietly into the muted green base. The overall mean base green stays unchanged. The clusters remain clearly larger than a single logical pixel, but are softly noticeable through their shape rather than brightness.
No shrinkage of any clusters, no extra tiny specks, no new detail, no altered distribution, no gradients, no vignette, no ground color variation. Retain a 64x64 logical pixel-art grid shown enlarged. No text, border or watermark.
